metadata.title: The Pharmacy and Poisons (Conduct of Clinical Trials) Rules, 2022 (Legal Notice No. 95)
metadata.edition: Made 8 June 2022; Kenya Gazette Supplement No. 96 of 9 June 2022 · rules 8 and 12 (SUSARs 7 and 15 days, foreign trials of the same product, annual safety report)
metadata.legal_basis: Subsidiary legislation under the Pharmacy and Poisons Act (Cap. 244); the Kenya Gazette text governs.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
